note: Batch supplied by the client over WhatsApp on 2 Sep 2026 as 147 photographs (two sends: ~12:27-12:38 PM and 6:24-6:42 PM), saved to 'stadium supply media/products/'. No price captions arrived with this batch, so every price below is taken from the standing tier table in client-pricing-and-sizing-audit.md (the client's own 27 Aug list) rather than from a caption.
photoOrder: Photos are indexed 1-147 in chronological order of the WhatsApp filename timestamp - the order they arrived in the chat. The import script re-derives the same order from the filenames.
identification: Kits identified from the garment itself. Current-season identifications were checked against the published kit record: Chelsea 26/27 home is the Bright Blue button-collar shirt with the Midwest Gold rampant lion and a tonal full-crest weave (the first modern Chelsea home without the contemporary badge); Chelsea 26/27 away is the black shirt with Midwest Gold logos and graphic collar/cuff panels, launched 21 Jul 2026; Chelsea 26/27 third is the white shirt with thin red pinstripes and the 1990s shielded crest. Inter 26/27 home is black and Lyon Blue with University Gold detail; Inter 26/27 away is the baseball-inspired white shirt with blue pinstripes and the crest redrawn as a monogram, released 17 Jul 2026; Inter 26/27 third is Iron Grey with a black horizontal band and a blue border, launched Aug 2026; the Thunder Blue and Safety Orange Total-90-template shirt is the Inter 25/26 third; the pale pixel-graphic shirt is the Inter 25/26 away.
priceNote: Tier table: fan R500 (S-4XL), fan long sleeve R600 (S-4XL), player R650 (S-2XL), player long sleeve R750 (S-2XL), retro R700 (S-2XL), hoodie / sweatshirt R850, half-zip tracksuit R850, full-zip or windbreaker jacket R1000, training top and shorts set R600, adults training vest-and-shorts set R700, kids set R450, F1 jersey/polo/tee R650, F1 jacket R1200.

flagForClient.question: Photos 1 and 3 are the Chelsea 26/27 home without the button placket and with gold side piping; photos 2 and 4 have the button placket. Imported as player version (1, 3) and fan version (2, 4) - confirm that split.
Black and blue checked adidas Samsung shirt - listed as Chelsea 2011/12 third; confirm the season.
Two black Chelsea Total-90-era shirts with the old round CFC crest. Listed by description rather than by season because the crest, the Nike badge and the Total 90 mark do not agree on a single year.
Two close crops of a Nike black-and-blue striped Inter shirt with the 1908 roundel crest. Attached to the Inter 2002/03 home (photo 116); confirm they are the same shirt.
Listed as Chelsea 2012/13 home after matching the supplier album labelled 1213 - the gold Samsung shirt is the European-champions season, not 2010/11 as first read.
Inter 2004/05 third and 1995/96 away were re-dated from the supplier album labels; the Umbro short-sleeve striped home is listed as 1997/98 because Inter moved from Umbro to Nike in 1998.

Inter white away with the Nike Total 90 collar tab is listed as 2008/09, but its photographs match supplier album 181809523 exactly and that album is labelled "0405 season" — and Total 90 is a mid-2000s mark. Likely 2004/05. Left as imported rather than renaming a live listing; say the word and I will correct the title (the handle can stay, so no URL breaks).

supplierNote: Each product below with a supplierPhotos block was matched by eye to an album in the ezfashion supplier catalogue, and up to three extra studio photographs were pulled from it (front, back and a detail crop) to sit after the client photographs. Supplier size charts and images repeated across albums were filtered out. 48 of the 77 products have supplier extras; the rest had no confident match in the catalogue and ship with the client photographs alone. Three products (Inter 26/27 third fan and player, Liverpool 26/27 third kids) were matched to the wrong albums on the first pass: the gallery crawl paired each album id with the FOLLOWING card title, because the card markup puts title before href. Re-crawled with the corrected parse, confirmed against each album's own <title>, verified by eye, and appended with scripts/append-supplier-media.mjs.
